question_text: Which of the following statements is not true regarding progressive transverse waves in a stretched string?

options.option_text: Direction of the motion of particles in the string is normal to the direction of propagation of the wave.
The speed of the wave is directly proportional to the square root of the mass per unit length of the string when the tension of the string is constant.
Energy carried by the wave depends on the amplitude of the wave.
Two adjacent particles of the string do not move with the same speed at a given instant.
The speed of the wave is independent of the frequency of the wave.
